Senior Product Designer — Stelvio Logistics

About Stelvio
Stelvio Logistics builds the operating system for cross-border freight. Our shippers move $4.5B of goods through our platform every year. Design touches every part of the experience: dispatcher consoles, driver mobile apps, customer dashboards, and the internal tooling our operations team lives in. We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to own end-to-end design for our Dispatcher Console product line.

What you'll do
- Lead end-to-end design for the Dispatcher Console, from research through high-fidelity ship
- Run discovery research with dispatchers, drivers, and operations specialists; translate findings into product strategy
- Build and maintain the design system shared across our 4 product lines
- Pair daily with two product managers and four engineers; present in weekly Design Critique
- Ship complex multi-step workflows that balance information density with clarity
- Mentor two junior designers; review their work weekly

Requirements
- 6+ years of product design experience, with at least 3 years on B2B / operational software
- Demonstrated ability to design data-dense interfaces (dashboards, queues, complex tables)
- Fluency in Figma; comfort prototyping interactive flows
- Strong written communication; you've authored design briefs that aligned cross-functional teams
- Experience running and synthesising user research; familiarity with both qualitative and quantitative methods
- Comfort working closely with engineering, including reviewing implementation in staging
- Portfolio that shows shipped work — not concept-only projects

Bonus points
- Experience with logistics, supply chain, or operations-heavy domains
- Background in motion design or micro-interaction craft
- Front-end coding ability (React, CSS) sufficient to prototype directly
- Experience leading design-system stewardship at scale
- Prior work in safety-critical or workflow-critical environments

What we offer
- Competitive base + equity
- Hybrid in New York or Toronto; remote-friendly for the right candidate
- Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and 401(k) match
- $2,000 annual learning budget; conference attendance encouraged
- 12 weeks parental leave

Stelvio Logistics is committed to building a diverse, inclusive design team. We strongly encourage applications from underrepresented backgrounds.
